title: The User Experience of Chatbots
takeaway: 10 chatbot-UX laws: disclose bot-identity; state the bot's tasks; tolerate typos; free-text + buttons both; allow sort/filter; carry info task-to-task; infer context; allow jumps in the flow; BE HONEST on not-understanding; always an escape hatch to a human.
